description: Named the finger and a half, and asked after the children.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Asked the question, was stopped by the answer, judged the loaf, and took the threepence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Asked whether the corn was up, and did not ask for a price or a new name.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Answered for Anne, the corn, and the children, and paid threepence without a new count.
name: William Shakespeare
